## BlackRock makes outsized new $7.73B entry in Monolithic Power Systems alongside two other institutions

BlackRock initiating a multi-billion-dollar stake in MPWR signals notable institutional conviction in the power management semiconductor story, which sits at the intersection of AI data center power delivery demand — a key structural theme for the portfolio.

- BlackRock disclosed a new $7.73B position in MPWR — characterized as outsized relative to routine institutional flows.
- Commerzbank and Mitsubishi UFJ Asset Management also disclosed new MPWR investments; sizes for those two not specified in headlines.
- All three characterized as new positions, suggesting fresh conviction rather than incremental adds.
- Medium-confidence signal; BlackRock's scale alone elevates this above typical 13F noise.
